transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm just... I'm not sleeping right. I work overnights, and when I get off, I just lie there. Wide awake. And if I do fall asleep, I wake up feeling scared. It doesn't even feel like I rested.
Do you think your overnight work schedule is contributing to your sleep problems?
I guess so. I mean... it started about a year and two months ago. That's when my agency switched me to rotating overnights. And they added all this extra paperwork, too. So... probably.
Do you have bad dreams or nightmares?
Not really. I don't... I don't really remember my dreams. I just wake up like that.
Do you feel anxious or on edge during the day?
Um... I don't think so. Not really. I just... I mostly just feel tired.
Do you find yourself avoiding going to work or certain tasks at work?

I guess... yeah. I just... I can't really keep up with my care visits safely anymore. My supervisor actually had to stop me during one of the care-plan visits. I just got stuck... it was too much. I can barely manage work and getting home, so... I haven't been going to church, or Zumba, or mentoring or anything. I just go home.
Is avoiding work or certain tasks at work something you're doing because you feel overwhelmed or because you're afraid of something specific happening?
I don't know... I just... it's just too much. I'm not really afraid of anything, I just... I can't do it.
Have you experienced something traumatic or very stressful at work?
No... not really. Just normal work stuff. Nothing bad happened... I just... I don't know.
Do you think you would be able to sleep normally if you were working a daytime schedule?

I don't know... probably not. My sleep is just... it's all broken up now. I get off my overnight shift and just lie there wide awake. And if I do finally drift off... I just wake up scared. It feels like I never rested at all.
Do you often feel extremely sleepy during the day?
Not really... I mean, I'm always tired, but... I don't really feel sleepy. I just... I don't know. I just lay there.
Do you think your sleep problems would improve if you weren't working overnight shifts?
I don't know... maybe. I haven't really... thought about it. I just don't think it would make a difference right now. I don't know.
Do you think your sleep problems would be better if you had a regular daytime schedule and slept at night?
I mean... I guess I just said... I don't really know. I haven't tried it so... I can't say for sure.
Do you think your sleep problems would improve if you had a consistent sleep schedule?

I... I don't think it's just the schedule. That's actually why I came in... my sleep is just all broken up now. Even when I get off my overnight shift, I just lie there wide awake. And... when I finally do drift off, I wake up scared. I just feel like I never rested at all. So... I don't think a schedule would fix that.
Do you often fall asleep unintentionally during the day?
No... I don't really do that. I just... I can't sleep.
Do you think your sleep would improve if you were able to work a normal daytime schedule and sleep at night like most people?
I just... I don't know. I feel like we already talked about this. I haven't tried it, so I really couldn't tell you.
Do you ever fall asleep during activities like reading, watching TV, or eating?
No... not really. I just... I can't sleep. That's the problem.
Do you ever feel extremely sleepy during the day, to the point where it interferes with your daily activities?
No... I don't get sleepy like that. I'm just... drained. But I stay awake.
Do you think your body has a hard time adjusting to the overnight work schedule?
I guess... yeah. It's just all broken up now. I get off my shift and... I just lie there, wide awake. And then, if I finally do drift off, I wake up scared. I just... I never feel rested.
Do you ever feel like you might doze off or fall asleep during the day when you're not trying to?
No... I don't really doze off. Like I said, I just... I don't fall asleep like that. I'm just awake.
Do you ever feel so tired during the day that it interferes with your daily activities?
I mean... I'm tired, yeah. But... I don't know. I don't really do much anyway. I just kind of... sit there.
Do you think your sleep problems started after you began working overnight shifts?
Yeah... I guess so. It's been going on for... maybe a year and two months. That's when the agency switched me to rotating overnights... and gave me all this extra paperwork. So... yeah.
